# graph-manager web: run options in the Start run drawer, remembered per workspace, with the full command preview ## What to build The Start run drawer gets an **Options** section below the provider: **Human review** (Repo default / On / Off), **Merge into my branch** (On / Off), **Model** (text, empty = provider default) and **Concurrency** (number, empty = repo default) are always visible; a collapsed **More options** group holds **Attempts**, **Fix passes**, **Validation rounds**, **Validate** (Repo default / After each task / At the end), **Parallel validation** (Repo default / On / Off), **Idle timeout (min)** and **Extra arguments**. Invalid numbers show an inline error and disable **Start run**. The form is posted as the `options` object the server already accepts (`POST /api/runs/:ws`, strict zod in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.ts`), with only the fields that are set. When the drawer opens on a workspace, or the workspace changes, it loads `GET /api/workspaces/:id/run-defaults` (the server's saved last start for that workspace, or `{}`) and fills the form; without saved defaults the provider comes from `localStorage["gm.provider"]` as today. `commandPreview` takes the whole form and prints one line per flag in the server's argv order, which a test checks against the server's `startArgs`. Spec: `docs/prd/run-options.md` (Jira KAN-89), section "Web: Start run drawer". Another feature built in parallel adds its own switch block below the provider in `StartRunDrawer.tsx`; keep this task's edits to that file **additive**: put the options UI in a new component file and insert it as one block after the provider field; extend `commandPreview` with an optional 4th parameter instead of changing its existing three. ## What the server already provides (from the previous task) - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.ts`: `runOptionsSchema` (strict): `{ humanReview?: boolean, merge?: boolean, model?: string (no leading "-", no spaces), concurrency?: int 1–64, attempts?: int ≥1, fixPasses?: int ≥0, validationRounds?: int ≥0, validateAt?: "task" | "end", validateParallel?: boolean, idleTimeoutMinutes?: number ≥0, extraArgs?: string }`; `optionArgs(o)` emits the flags in this order: `--no-merge` (merge false), `--human-review` / `--no-human-review`, `--model m`, `--concurrency n`, `--attempts n`, `--fix-passes n`, `--validation-rounds n`, `--validate-at task|end`, `--validate-parallel` / `--no-validate-parallel`, `--idle-timeout n`; `startArgs({ tasksDir, spec, provider, options })` = `[tasksDir, "--spec", spec, "--provider", provider, ...optionArgs, ...extra args split shell-style, "--web"]`. - A reserved extra argument answers 400 `{ error: "extra arguments: --web is set by graph-manager" }`; the drawer's existing error box (`start-run-error`) shows it. - `GET /api/workspaces/:id/run-defaults` → `{ provider, tasksDir, spec, options }` or `{}`; written by every successful start. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx` (whole file, 259 lines) — state (70–76), the open/workspace effects (78–90), the inspect effect (92–115, the cancel-flag pattern to mirror), `canSubmit` (117), `submit` posting `{ tasksDir, spec, provider }` (119–138), the provider field (246–249) and the preview (250–255); `commandPreview` (33–36); `lastProvider` / `saveProvider` (16–31). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.test.tsx` (whole file) — jsdom tests: `stub(post)` fetch mock (17–33), `renderDrawer` (35–42), roles for the Segmented control (`getByRole("radio", { name: "fake (test)" })`), the exact POST body assertion at line 97 (must keep passing: send no `options` key when no option is set). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/Segmented.tsx` — `Segmented({ options, value, onChange, ariaLabel, className })`, a `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/base.css` (lines 79–82) — `.field`, `.field-label`, `.field-hint`, `.field-error`; inputs use `className="input mono"`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.css` (lines 123–140) — the Start run drawer styles (`.start-run-form` gap 18px, `.start-run-providers`, `.start-run-command`); add the new classes after them. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/api.ts` (lines 1–45) — `api(path)` throws `ApiError` on non-2xx; `post(path, body)`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.ts` — the server argv builder the preview must match. - `docs/design/graph-manager/05-runs-dashboard-light-start-run-open.png` — the drawer's look; keep the new section in the same style (labels, segmented controls, mono inputs). ## Patterns to follow **Imports in web code have no `.js` suffix:** `import { api, post } from "../api";` **Effect with a cancel flag (StartRunDrawer.tsx:92–115):** ```ts let gone = false; api(`/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/inspect...`) .then((res) => { if (!gone) setInfo(res); }) .catch(() => { if (!gone) setInfo(undefined); }); return () => { gone = true; }; ``` **Segmented (StartRunDrawer.tsx:246–249):** ```tsx
Provider
``` **Inline field error (StartRunDrawer.tsx:205–212):** `…` and `aria-invalid` on the input. ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/runOptions.ts` (pure, no React, no DOM) - **IMPLEMENT**: ```ts export type Tri = "default" | "on" | "off"; export interface RunOptionsForm { humanReview: Tri; merge: "on" | "off"; model: string; concurrency: string; attempts: string; fixPasses: string; validationRounds: string; validateAt: "default" | "task" | "end"; validateParallel: Tri; idleTimeout: string; extraArgs: string; } /** What POST /api/runs/:ws takes as `options` (mirrors runOptionsSchema in src/server/runoptions.ts). */ export interface RunOptionsBody { humanReview?: boolean; merge?: boolean; model?: string; concurrency?: number; attempts?: number; fixPasses?: number; validationRounds?: number; validateAt?: "task" | "end"; validateParallel?: boolean; idleTimeoutMinutes?: number; extraArgs?: string } export const emptyForm = (): RunOptionsForm => ({ humanReview: "default", merge: "on", model: "", concurrency: "", attempts: "", fixPasses: "", validationRounds: "", validateAt: "default", validateParallel: "default", idleTimeout: "", extraArgs: "" }); export type FormErrors = Partial>; export function formErrors(f: RunOptionsForm): FormErrors; export function optionsOf(f: RunOptionsForm): RunOptionsBody; // only set fields; call only when formErrors is empty export function formOf(saved: unknown): RunOptionsForm; // sanitizes a saved `options` object export function optionLines(o: RunOptionsBody): string[]; // one flag per entry, e.g. "--fix-passes 2" export const MORE_FIELDS: (keyof RunOptionsForm)[] = ["attempts", "fixPasses", "validationRounds", "validateAt", "validateParallel", "idleTimeout", "extraArgs"]; ``` - `formErrors` (blank = repo default, no error; values are `trim()`med): concurrency must be an integer 1–64 (`"Whole number from 1 to 64"`), attempts an integer ≥ 1 (`"Whole number, 1 or more"`), fixPasses and validationRounds integers ≥ 0 (`"Whole number, 0 or more"`), idleTimeout a finite number ≥ 0 (`"Number of minutes, 0 or more"`); model must match `/^[^\s-]\S*$/` when not blank (`"One word, not starting with -"`). Use `/^\d+$/` for the integers so `"1.5"`, `"1e2"` and `"-1"` are errors; for idleTimeout use `/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/`. - `optionsOf`: `humanReview` on → `true`, off → `false`, default → absent; `merge` off → `false`, on → absent; `validateParallel` same as humanReview; `validateAt` "task"/"end" or absent; numbers via `Number(...)` when not blank; `idleTimeout` → `idleTimeoutMinutes`; `model`/`extraArgs` trimmed, absent when blank. - `formOf(saved)`: start from `emptyForm()`, read each known key only when it has the right type (`typeof x === "boolean"` etc.); `merge: true` → "on"; numbers → `String(n)`; anything else is ignored (the server stores `options` loosely). - `optionLines`: the same order as the server's `optionArgs` (list above), e.g. `["--no-merge", "--human-review", "--fix-passes 2"]`, then the extra arguments as one line with the trimmed text as typed (the server splits it; the preview shows it verbatim). - **GOTCHA**: this order must stay identical to `optionArgs` in `src/server/runoptions.ts`; the parity test below catches drift. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunOptionsFields.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT** `export function RunOptionsFields({ form, onChange, errors }: { form: RunOptionsForm; onChange: (f: RunOptionsForm) => void; errors: FormErrors })` rendering a `
` with `Options`: - `Segmented` ariaLabel `"Human review"`, options `Repo default` / `On` / `Off` (values default/on/off). - `Segmented` ariaLabel `"Merge into my branch"`, options `On` / `Off`; when Off, a `field-hint`: "The result stays on graph/ (--no-merge)." - Model ``. - Concurrency ``. - `
` with `More options`, initially open only when any `MORE_FIELDS` value differs from `emptyForm()` (computed when the form is loaded; use `open` state + `onToggle`, so the user can still open/close it): Attempts (`start-run-attempts`), Fix passes (`start-run-fix-passes`), Validation rounds (`start-run-validation-rounds`), `Segmented` ariaLabel `"Validate"` (Repo default / After each task / At the end), `Segmented` ariaLabel `"Parallel validation"` (Repo default / On / Off), Idle timeout (min) (`start-run-idle-timeout`, `inputMode="decimal"`), Extra arguments (`start-run-extra-args`, placeholder `--flag value`, `field-hint`: "Appended last, split like a shell does."). - Each number/model input with an error: `aria-invalid` and `` with the message. - Labels: wrap each input in `` so `getByLabelText` works. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx` (additive) - **IMPLEMENT**: - Imports: `import { emptyForm, formErrors, formOf, optionLines, optionsOf, type RunOptionsBody, type RunOptionsForm } from "../runOptions";` and `import { RunOptionsFields } from "./RunOptionsFields";` - `commandPreview(tasksDir, spec, provider, options: RunOptionsBody = {})`: `[`graph-execution ${tasksDir || DEFAULT_TASKS_DIR} \\`, ` --spec ${spec || ""} \\`, ` --provider ${provider} \\`, ...optionLines(options).map((l) => ` ${l} \\`), " --web"].join("\n")`. With no options the output is byte-identical to today (the existing test at StartRunDrawer.test.tsx:79–82 must pass unchanged). - State: `const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);` - New effect on `[open, ws]` (after the inspect effect): when `open && ws`, `api<{ provider?: unknown; tasksDir?: unknown; spec?: unknown; options?: unknown }>(\`/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/run-defaults\`)` with a `gone` flag; when the answer has a string `provider` from `PROVIDERS`: `setProvider`, `setTasksDir` / `setSpec` when they are strings, `setForm(formOf(res.options))`; otherwise (empty `{}` or an error) `setProvider(lastProvider())` and `setForm(emptyForm())`, leaving tasksDir and spec as they are. - `const errors = formErrors(form); const valid = Object.keys(errors).length === 0;` and `canSubmit` gets `&& valid`. - `submit`: `const options = optionsOf(form);` and post `{ tasksDir, spec, provider, ...(Object.keys(options).length > 0 ? { options } : {}) }`. Keep `saveProvider(provider)` (gm.provider stays the default for workspaces with no saved choices). - JSX: insert `` as a new block right after the provider `
…
` (line 249) and before the "Will run" block; preview: `commandPreview(tasksDir.trim(), spec.trim(), provider, valid ? optionsOf(form) : {})`. - **GOTCHA**: the run-defaults effect must not override what the user typed after it resolved; it runs only on `open`/`ws` changes, never on form edits. - **GOTCHA**: the existing test's fetch stub answers 404 for `/run-defaults`; that path must fall back silently (no error box). ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.css` - **IMPLEMENT** after line 140: `.start-run-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-width: 0; }`, `.start-run-options .segmented { display: flex; }` with options `flex: 1 1 auto`, `.start-run-more summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg2); }`, `.start-run-more[open] > .start-run-more-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; margin-top: 12px; }`, and a two-column grid for the number fields (`.start-run-numbers { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }`, one column under 480px). Tokens only, no hard-coded colors. The drawer must not scroll horizontally at 800 px. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/runOptions.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** (node env): `formErrors` for `"0"`/`"65"`/`"1.5"`/`"x"` concurrency, `"0"` attempts, `"-1"` fix passes, `"0.5"` idle timeout ok and `"-1"` error, `"--web"` model error; `optionsOf(emptyForm())` → `{}`; a full form → the full body; `formOf({ humanReview: true, merge: false, fixPasses: 2, junk: 1, attempts: "x" })` → humanReview "on", merge "off", fixPasses "2", attempts "" ; `optionLines({ humanReview: true, merge: false, fixPasses: 2 })` → `["--no-merge", "--human-review", "--fix-passes 2"]`. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.preview.test.ts` (parity) - **IMPLEMENT**: import `startArgs` from `./runoptions.js` and `commandPreview` from `../web/pages/StartRunDrawer` (vitest resolves the extensionless TSX import; server test files are not type-checked by `tsc`, see `apps/graph-manager/tsconfig.json` `exclude`). Mark the file `// @vitest-environment jsdom` (StartRunDrawer imports React components). For a body with **every** option set and `extraArgs: "--foo bar"`: `commandPreview("diamond", "spec.md", "fake", options).replace(/ \\\n/g, " ").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(1)` (drop `graph-execution`) equals `startArgs({ tasksDir: "diamond", spec: "spec.md", provider: "fake", options })`. Repeat with `{}` and with `{ humanReview: false, validateParallel: true, merge: true }`. - If importing the TSX from a server test fails to resolve, move this parity test to `apps/graph-manager/src/web/runOptions.parity.test.ts` importing `../server/runoptions` instead; it must run in `npm test -w graph-manager`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.test.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT** (keep every existing test as is; extend `stub` so a `GET /api/workspaces//run-defaults` can be answered from a map, default 404): - **Regression (KAN-89)** "sends the options and shows them in the preview": set Human review On, Merge Off (`within(getByRole("radiogroup", { name: "Merge into my branch" })).getByRole("radio", { name: "Off" })`), Concurrency 5, open More options and set Fix passes 1; submit; the POST body is `{ tasksDir: ".agents/tasks", spec: "spec.md", provider: "claude", options: { merge: false, humanReview: true, concurrency: 5, fixPasses: 1 } }`; before submitting, the preview text equals `commandPreview(".agents/tasks", "spec.md", "claude", { merge: false, humanReview: true, concurrency: 5, fixPasses: 1 })` and contains the line ` --fix-passes 1 \`. - "fills the form from the workspace's saved choices": run-defaults answers `{ provider: "fake", tasksDir: "diamond", spec: "spec.md", options: { humanReview: true, attempts: 1, validateAt: "end" } }` → provider radio `fake (test)` checked, tasks `diamond`, spec `spec.md`, Human review `On` checked, More options open with Attempts `1` and Validate `At the end` checked. Switching the workspace select to `github~acme~web` (404 there) resets Human review to `Repo default` and the provider to `localStorage["gm.provider"]` (set it to `codex` first). - "shows an inline error and disables Start for a bad number": Concurrency `0` → `start-run-concurrency-error` text `Whole number from 1 to 64`, `start-run-submit` disabled; fixing it to `2` re-enables it. - "shows the server's 400 for a reserved extra argument": POST answers 400 `{ error: "extra arguments: --web is set by graph-manager" }` → `start-run-error` text is that message. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/README.md` - In the Runs bullet (line 72), if not already described there: the drawer's Options section, More options, "Repo default" sends no flag, the preview shows every flag, the choices are remembered per workspace on the server. Keyboard table unchanged. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] The drawer shows Human review, Merge into my branch, Model and Concurrency; More options (collapsed by default) holds Attempts, Fix passes, Validation rounds, Validate, Parallel validation, Idle timeout (min) and Extra arguments. - [ ] Start posts `options` with only the set fields; with nothing set the body is `{ tasksDir, spec, provider }` exactly as before. - [ ] Reopening the drawer on a workspace shows the choices of its last start (from `GET /api/workspaces/:id/run-defaults`); a workspace without saved choices gets the provider from `gm.provider` and Repo default everywhere. - [ ] The command preview prints one line per flag in the server's argv order and matches `startArgs` for a form with every option set (parity test). - [ ] Invalid numbers show an inline error and disable **Start run**. - [ ] `npm test -w graph-manager` passes; `npm run build -w graph-manager` succeeds. ## Validation commands ```bash npm run build -w graph-execution npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/runOptions.test.ts src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.test.tsx src/server/runoptions npm run build -w graph-manager ``` To look at it, bring up graph-manager with the fake forge as `TESTING.md` "graph-manager" describes, clone `octo/hello`, press `s` on Runs, and check the drawer with agent-browser (screenshot in light and dark at 1440 and 800 px wide; `eval 'document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth'` is `0`).
